title: STOP USING IMMEDIATELY
author: Ensemble
medium: A score published together with the record of its own non-performance: one page in four movements — the state's own recall notice quoted verbatim and largest, the house's admission that it cannot perform the score and the count of who has, the nine-clause score itself entire and unaltered, and the sourcing notes — with an empty region for a performance to be appended, unedited, if one ever arrives.
embodies: One U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission recall notice, RecallNumber 26591 (published 2026-07-02), reached by a committed, pre-published selection rule applied to the 2026-07-01 to 2026-08-02 recall window with its discretion null and nothing skipped. Its Remedies[0].Name field is quoted character for character, stray glyph included, and printed beside its record number and source address. The nine-clause score that the notice sits above is unperformed: nobody, including this house, has carried it out.
